description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the AccessFlowStateMachineService component in the OrangeHRM project. It contains multiple test methods validating the behavior of access flow state machine operations such as fetching allowed actions, next states, saving/deleting records, and handling user role changes within the HRM system.

classes.name: AccessFlowStateMachineServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the AccessFlowStateMachineService, validating functionality related to workflow state transitions and access permissions within the HR management system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineService and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Verifies the getter method returns an instance of AccessFlowStateMachineDao.

methods.name: testSetAccessFlowStateMachineDao
methods.description: Tests the setter method for setting the DAO and verifies correct assignment.

methods.name: testGetAllowedActions
methods.description: Checks retrieval of allowed actions for specified flow, state, and role, including null case.

methods.name: testGetAllowedWorkflowItems
methods.description: Asserts that allowed workflow items are correctly fetched for given parameters.

methods.name: testGetNextState
methods.description: Validates the retrieval of the next state based on current flow, state, role, and action, including null scenario.

methods.name: testGetActionableStates
methods.description: Ensures that the service correctly fetches states that are actionable given a set of actions, flow, and role.

methods.name: testSaveWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Tests saving a workflow state machine record returns the saved object.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowStateMachineRecord
methods.description: Validates deletion of a workflow state machine record and success/failure scenarios.

methods.name: testGetWorkFlowStateMachineRecordsService
methods.description: Checks retrieving all workflow state machine records for a specific flow.

methods.name: testIsActionAllowedService
methods.description: Verifies whether a specific action is allowed for a given flow, state, role, and action.

methods.name: testGetWorkflowItemsByStateActionAndRole
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a workflow item matching specific state, action, and role.

methods.name: testDeleteWorkflowRecordsForUserRole
methods.description: Ensures deletion of all workflow records associated with a specific user role.

methods.name: testHandleUserRoleRename
methods.description: Validates handling of renaming user roles within the workflow records.
